title: Deep Learning Network of Amomum villosum Quality Classification and Origin Identification Based on X-ray Technology
summary: The source reports high defect-classification performance on 386 validation images and also evaluates origin classification on validation data. Validation covers sampled images and two source regions; broader origin generalization and deployment performance are not established.
ai_technology: AFNet classifies Amomum villosum X-ray images for fruit quality and geographic origin.
organization: Xin-Huangpu Joint Innovation Institute of Chinese Medicine, Guangzhou, China; State Key Laboratory of Component Traditional Chinese Medicine, Tianjin, China
